# Factorize

Hosted workflow: connect your agent → create a skill → run it → inspect the result → configure its trigger.

Application: https://app.factorize.sh
MCP (Streamable HTTP + OAuth): https://app.factorize.sh/mcp

Browser: unique username signup, username or email/password login, skill settings, execution/provider connections and consent.
MCP: discover targets, manage triggers, invoke with retained idempotency keys, inspect state/context/diagnostics.
Current MCP does not return execution output; inspect browser traces or REST trace pages. REST is not full MCP parity.

## Get started

- [Factorize with your agent](https://docs.factorize.sh/): Connect your agent, create a trigger, run it, inspect the result, and automate it.
- [Connect your agent](https://docs.factorize.sh/mcp/overview): Authorize Codex or Claude Code for hosted Factorize.
- [Your first skill](https://docs.factorize.sh/quickstart): Configure a personal team and run hosted Pi through MCP.

## Work with your agent

- [Skills and presets](https://docs.factorize.sh/work/skills): Define skills in SKILL.md and reuse team VM, permission and model presets.
- [Create and edit triggers](https://docs.factorize.sh/work/triggers): Configure skill event sources and retain compatibility with trigger clients.
- [Write Trigger context](https://docs.factorize.sh/work/prompts): Combine one optional skill, a literal prompt, and selected Event data.
- [Inspect results](https://docs.factorize.sh/work/results): Read run state, output, prompt, and event context.
- [Stop and retry runs](https://docs.factorize.sh/work/stop-retry): Avoid duplicate work and understand current stop behavior.

## Automate triggers

- [Schedule a repository review](https://docs.factorize.sh/recipes/scheduled-review): Turn a successful manual review into daily automation.
- [Run a trigger from Linear](https://docs.factorize.sh/recipes/linear-trigger): Connect a workspace, select a project and match issues.
- [Automate from GitHub](https://docs.factorize.sh/integrations/github): Select an installation, repository, and event.
- [Automate from ClickUp](https://docs.factorize.sh/integrations/clickup): Connect a workspace and select matching tasks.
- [Chain triggers](https://docs.factorize.sh/recipes/chaining): Start a follow-up after another trigger finishes or is edited.
- [Manual trigger invocation permissions](https://docs.factorize.sh/work/manual-invocation-permissions): Authorize triggers to start other triggers with run-scoped credentials and manage destination permissions.
- [Connect your accounts](https://docs.factorize.sh/integrations/oauth): Browser setup, resource access, and delivery verification.
- [Event configuration](https://docs.factorize.sh/integrations/events): Configure schedules, provider webhooks, and lifecycle events.

## Troubleshooting

- [Connection problems](https://docs.factorize.sh/troubleshooting/connection): Recover authorization, scopes, and execution integrations.
- [Triggers not firing](https://docs.factorize.sh/troubleshooting/events): Verify automation from provider event to accepted run.
- [Failed or stuck runs](https://docs.factorize.sh/troubleshooting/runs): Investigate evidence, fix the cause, and verify recovery.

## Reference

- [MCP tool reference](https://docs.factorize.sh/mcp/tools): Complete hosted MCP inventory, inputs, results, and common errors.
- [Teams, Triggers, Events, skills, and runs](https://docs.factorize.sh/concepts): Understand the shared team workspace and hosted Pi execution.
- [REST API reference](https://docs.factorize.sh/api/reference): How to use the generated API reference.
- [Authentication and scopes](https://docs.factorize.sh/api/authentication): OAuth 2.1, device authorization, and access-token rules.
- [OAuth discovery](https://docs.factorize.sh/api/discovery): Endpoints and metadata for OAuth-aware clients.
- [OpenAPI definition](https://docs.factorize.sh/api/openapi): Download the verified Factorize REST contract.
- [REST operations](https://docs.factorize.sh/openapi.yaml): Complete generated REST schemas and operations

## Self-hosting

- [Optional self-hosting](https://docs.factorize.sh/self-hosting/deployment): Deploy your own Factorize instance.
- [Operator configuration](https://docs.factorize.sh/self-hosting/configuration): Email, OAuth applications, webhooks, and Worker secrets.
- [Operations and advanced trace recovery](https://docs.factorize.sh/self-hosting/operations): Operator checks, retained artifacts, and rollout evidence.
- [Credential proxy cutover and recovery](https://docs.factorize.sh/self-hosting/credential-cutover): Operator and user procedure for retiring the separate credential proxy and reconnecting credentials for the per-run backend proxy.
- [Credential proxy architecture migration](https://docs.factorize.sh/self-hosting/credential-proxy-security): Status of the retired standalone proxy and link to the current migration procedure.
